privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: How Ethos Education collects, uses and protects the personal information of students and families using our study abroad counselling services.
privacy-policy.body:
**Effective Date: August 22nd, 2025**

At **Ethos Education Pvt. Ltd**, we are committed to safeguarding your privacy while providing personalized, high-quality skilling, mentorship, and educational services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, and the rights you have as a valued user.

Your trust is our priority — we handle your data with the highest standards of confidentiality, transparency, and security.

## Information We Collect

We collect only the information necessary to deliver and enhance your learning experience.

**a) Information You Provide**

**Personal Details :** Name, email, phone number, academic records, and career aspirations.

**Account Information :** Login credentials and profile data.

**Uploaded Documents :** Test scores, resumes, or essays — strictly for educational guidance.

**Guardian Details :** Where required, for applicants under 18.

**b) Automatically Collected Data**

**Technical Information :** Browser, device type, IP address.

**Usage Patterns :** Pages visited, time spent, and interactions with our platform.

**Cookies & Tracking** : To improve site functionality, remember preferences, and analyze user engagement.

**c) Third-Party Data**

Information from trusted service providers (e.g., payment gateways, analytics tools) that help us run our services smoothly.

## How We Use Your Information

Your data enables us to :

**Deliver Personalized Guidance :** Tailored learning paths, mentorship, and skill-building.

**Improve Services :** Analyse usage trends to make your experience better.

**Provide Support :** Handle queries, scheduling, and technical assistance.

**Communicate Effectively :** Share relevant updates, learning resources, and program recommendations.

**Ensure Safety :** Prevent fraud, misuse, or unauthorized access.

**Legal Compliance :** Meet applicable laws and regulations.

We never use your data beyond these purposes.

## Cookies & Tracking Tools

Cookies help us provide a smoother, faster experience by :

Remembering your login and preferences.

Customizing content for you.

Measuring performance and improving usability.

You can disable cookies in your browser at any time, though some features may not function properly.

## Information Sharing & Disclosure

We respect your privacy — **your information is never sold, rented, or traded.**

We may share your data only with:

**Mentors & Educators :** For personalized guidance, strictly with your consent.

**Service Providers :** Payment processors, hosting platforms, and communication tools bound by confidentiality.

**Legal Authorities :** Only when required to comply with law or protect rights.

**Affiliates/Partners :** To provide extended learning opportunities — always under strict privacy controls.

## Your Rights & Choices

You are in full control of your data. You have the right to :

**Access & Update :** Correct inaccuracies in your profile.

**Withdraw Consent :** Stop certain data uses at any time.

**Opt-Out of Marketing :** Easily unsubscribe from non-essential communications.

**Request Deletion :** Ask us to erase your data, subject to regulatory requirements.

To exercise these rights, contact us at [**info@ethoseducation.world**](mailto:info@ethoseducation.world) .

## Data Security & Retention

We use industry-grade encryption, firewalls, and secure servers to protect your information.

Data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide services or meet legal obligations.

Anonymized data may be used for analytics and research.

Your privacy is **non-negotiable** – safeguarding it is part of our core values.

## External Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. Please note: we are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party sites. We encourage you to review their policies before sharing personal information.

## Policy Updates

This policy may be updated to reflect changes in our practices or legal obligations. Updates will be posted with a **revised effective date** at the top of this page. Continued use of our services implies acceptance of these changes.

## Governing Law

This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of **India/Haryana** and is designed in compliance with data protection regulations such as the **Information Technology Act, 2000 (India)** and applicable global standards.

Subject to your compliance with the Terms of Use, we grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, limited privilege to enter and use the Website/Application.

## Acceptance of Terms

By registering for or using our skilling and mentorship services, you agree to abide by these Terms & Conditions. These terms form a binding agreement between you (the learner, applicant, or user) and [**info@ethoseducation.world**](mailto:info@ethoseducation.world) .

## Services Offered

We provide skilling pathways, certifications, mentorship, and related career services. Each program is delivered as described on our website and is intended for the enrolled individual only.

## Payment Terms & Fees

All fees are paid in full at enrolment and are **final**, unless a rare exception applies. Fees are specific to the applicant and the selected program and are :

**Non-refundable, non-transferable, and non-adjustable**, whether in part or whole.

Non-transferable to other cycles, services, or individuals.

## Cancellation & Refund Exceptions

In general, services are non-refundable. Refunds will only be considered under exceptional circumstances, such as :

The service was not provided as advertised.

Significant unresolved technical issues prevented access.

Duplicate payments made in error.

**Affiliates/Partners :** To provide extended learning opportunities — always under strict privacy controls.

Refund requests must be submitted via email to  [**info@ethoseducation.world**](mailto:info@ethoseducation.world)  within **7 days** of purchase; approved refunds will be processed within **14 business days**.

## Subscription & Access

Some services may operate on a subscription model. Unless otherwise indicated, subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled prior to the renewal date. Cancelling stops future billing but does not guarantee a refund for the current period.

To exercise these rights, contact us at [**info@ethoseducation.world**](mailto:info@ethoseducation.world) .

## Intellectual Property & Use

All course content, materials, logos, and trademarks are owned by  [**info@ethoseducation.world**](mailto:info@ethoseducation.world)  . Users may access and use these for personal, educational purposes only. Unauthorized sharing, reproduction, or distribution is prohibited.

## User Conduct

You agree to use our platform responsibly and ethically. Misuse—including abuse of support, automated scraping, or harassment—may result in service suspension or termination without refund.

## Content Updates & Availability

We aim to provide accurate and up-to-date content, but may update or pause services due to maintenance, force majeure, or technical disruptions. We will use commercially reasonable efforts to restore access promptly.

## Limitation of Liability

We will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from your use or inability to use the service. Users must ensure they understand the platform’s offerings and limitations before purchase.

## Privacy & Data Use

Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. By using our services, you consent to our practices in handling your information.

## Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by the laws of [Specified Jurisdiction]. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of that jurisdiction.

## Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions periodically. The “Effective Date” will reflect the latest version. Continued use of our platform constitutes acceptance of changes.

Payments cannot be carried forward to future cycles, applied to alternate services, or reassigned to another individual under any circumstance.
